description: This PHP file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system version 5.1.0. It contains database schema changes, data updates, permission and language string management, and configuration updates related to HR management modules, including performance and recruitment features.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class responsible for database schema updates, data migration, permission setup, and language string management for OrangeHRM version 5.1.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main method executing all the migration steps including database updates, data permission insertions, language string updates, and configuration changes.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '5.1.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for LangStringHelper instance used for language string management.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for TranslationHelper instance used for translation management.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings to the specified version.

methods.name: addValidColumnToRequestResetPassword
methods.description: Adds a new 'expired' boolean column to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table.

methods.name: insertModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Inserts default page configurations for modules based on role and URL.

methods.name: insertReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states for review processes for admin and supervisor roles.

methods.name: insertSelfReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states for self-review processes for admin, supervisor, and ESS users.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts individual workflow state entries into the workflow state machine.

methods.name: insertReviewListScreenForAdminRole
methods.description: Assigns access permissions for the review list screen to the Admin role.

methods.name: modifyThemeTable
methods.description: Alters the 'ohrm_theme' table, modifying columns related to branding and theme variables.

methods.name: modifyTrackerLogsUserForeignKey
methods.description: Updates foreign key constraints on the 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' table for user references.

methods.name: modifyEmployeeTrackerScreenRolePermission
methods.description: Updates user role permissions for the 'viewEmployeePerformanceTrackerList' screen.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configuration for specific modules and screens.

methods.name: updateRecruitmentMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to recruitment features.

methods.name: updatePerformanceMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to performance features.
